lines.text: On the road to Jerusalem, Jesus tells the Twelve He will be delivered over to the Pharisees and Sadducees.
James and John, the sons of Zebedee, ask to sit at Jesus' right and left in His glory.
Jesus says they will drink His cup, but the seats at His right and left are not His to grant.
The ten become indignant with James and John, so Jesus says whoever wants to be great must be their master.
Jesus says whoever wants to be first must be slave of all, and the Son of Man came to serve.
